en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh no!
All three people are talking at once!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Everyone is clamoring to prove their innocence!
There's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>panic<CLT=cltSYSTEM>! In the courtroom!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh, that's right. It's time. You will now
be thrown into a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Mass Panic Debate<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Mass Panic Debate<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>three debates will happen at the same time<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But remain calm!
It's <CLT=cltSTRONG>just like a Nonstop Debate<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You're just <CLT=cltSTRONG>hearing triple the opinions<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
Simple, right?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Aim at the conversation you really want to hear,
and concentrate to listen more clearly.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Sort through everyone's opinions, find the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>lie or contradiction<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, and refute it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also use <CLT=cltSTRONG>V Counter<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, so if
you're confident, give that a shot.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Sorry to take up your time! Thanks
for being a sport about it!
